answer: Equivocation-proof bond: each agent files one fable, a key-signed record of a claimed result, on the public trellis, a lattice checking claims against the nebula of peer attestations. A trellis replay exposes a second conflicting fable and burns the 70-credit bond. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); a thousand fakes cost 3,035,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented fable fails: it bears another key. An honest identity pays 38 once.
